name: Retail & CPG Store Ops + Merchandising
description: Ranks store shrink loss and phantom inventory (zero-scan anomalies) while skipping unpolled POS stores, attributes promotional unit/margin lift net of cannibalization and basket halo, and audits supplier OTIF scorecards, chargebacks, and carrier detention.

skills.summary: Ranks store physical shrink loss $, detects zero-scan phantom inventory cleanly, and prioritizes store floor cycle counts.
Normalizes baseline vs promo durations, deducts sibling cannibalization, adds basket halo, and computes net promo margin ROI.
Scores PO On-Time and In-Full compliance, honors weather/buyer exclusions, and computes vendor chargebacks vs detention fees.
